name: CreateDataCache

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group for the ECI instance that is generated during the data cache creation process
parameters.help_zh: 创建数据缓存过程中生成的ECI实例所属的安全组ID
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch for the ECI instance that is generated during the data cache creation process
parameters.help_zh: 创建数据缓存过程中生成的ECI实例所属的交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The data storage bucket. The default value is default. You can specify a custom bucket to group services and prevent path conflicts.

eci-system is a reserved bucket for ECI and cannot be used
parameters.help_zh:
数据的存储空间。默认为default。支持自定义，以便进行业务分组和避免路径冲突。

eci-system为ECI保留空间，不可使用
parameters.name: bucket

parameters.help_en: The path where the data is stored
parameters.name: path

parameters.help_en: The name of the data cache
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The size of the data cache. Unit: GiB. The default value is 20 GiB. Evaluate the required size based on the actual amount of data
parameters.help_zh: 数据缓存大小。单位为GiB，默认为20 GiB。请根据实际数据量评估所需大小
parameters.name: size

fields.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

URL

NAS

OSS

SNAPSHOT
fields.help_zh:
数据源类型。取值范围：
URL
NAS
OSS
SNAPSHOT
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The parameters of the data source
fields.name: options

parameters.help_en: The number of days to retain the data cache. The data cache is cleared after it expires. By default, the data cache never expires
parameters.help_zh: 保留天数。过期会被清理。默认不过期
parameters.name: retention_days

parameters.help_en: The list of tags to attach to the data cache
parameters.help_zh: 数据缓存绑定的标签列表
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: A client token. It is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate a token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of an existing elastic IP address (EIP) to be attached.
If no NAT gateway is configured for the VPC, you can attach an EIP to pull data from the Internet
parameters.help_zh:
绑定已有的弹性公网IP（EIP）。
如果VPC没有配置NAT网关，可以绑定EIP，以便拉取公网数据
parameters.name: eip_instance_id

fields.help_en: The bandwidth of the EIP. Unit: Mbps. Default value: 5 Mbps
fields.help_zh: EIP带宽。单位为Mbps。默认为5 Mbps
fields.name: bandwidth

fields.help_en: The ID of an existing Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
fields.help_zh: 绑定已有的共享带宽包
fields.name: common_bandwidth_package

fields.help_en:
The billing method of the EIP. Valid values:

PayByBandwidth: pay-by-bandwidth

PayByTraffic: pay-by-data-transfer
fields.help_zh:
EIP的计量方式。取值范围：

PayByBandwidth：按带宽计费
PayByTraffic：按流量计费
fields.name: internet_charge_type

fields.help_en:
The ID of the IP address pool.
The EIP is allocated from the IP address pool.
By default, the IP address pool feature is unavailable. To use this feature, apply for the privilege in Quota Center
fields.help_zh:
IP地址池ID。
EIP将从该IP地址池中分配。
IP地址池功能默认不开放。如需使用，请在配额中心申请IP地址池功能权益配额
fields.name: public_ip_address_pool_id

fields.help_en:
The line type of the EIP. Valid values:

BGP (default): BGP (Multi-ISP)

BGP_PRO: BGP (Multi-ISP) Pro
fields.help_zh:
EIP的线路类型。取值范围：

BGP（默认值）：BGP（多线）线路
BGP_PRO：BGP（多线）精品线路
fields.name: isp

parameters.help_en:
The parameters for creating and attaching an EIP.
If no NAT gateway is configured for the VPC, you can attach an EIP to pull data from the Internet
parameters.help_zh:
创建一个弹性公网IP（EIP）并绑定。
如果VPC没有配置NAT网关，可以绑定EIP，以便拉取公网数据
parameters.name: eip_create_param
